description: A link for the guest to book a stay: the property page with the dates and guests chosen and the live price shown. Include the guest's details to have the booking form filled in for them (kept for 3 days). Nothing is booked or charged: the guest clicks Book, checks the details, accepts the rental agreement and pays.

checkIn.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Check-in is from 15:00 Bali time.

checkOut.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Check-out is by 11:00 Bali time.

children.description: Number of children. Children count towards the guest limit.

guest.description: Details to fill in on the booking form. The guest checks them before booking. Leave out anything you do not know.

country.description: Country of residence as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "AU".

phone.description: Phone number in international format with the country code, e.g. +61412345678.

infants.description: Number of infants (ages 0-2). Infants do not count towards the guest limit.

pets.description: Number of pets. Only some properties allow pets.

property.description: Property slug, as given in stay search results and the property list (e.g. "villa-kura-kura").

name: create_booking_link
title: Create a booking link
